_doc: Actor_A -> Actor_B production clip set (library 'actor_b_from_a'): every Actor_A clip that graph_analysis/melee_horse_prone/melee_prone.md (melee_prone_clips.json) and horse.md (sections 1.6-1.8) ask for. Entries merge `defaults`, then `groups[group]`, then their own keys. contacts: auto = automatic contact / grip detection (tools/retarget/contacts.py); anchor / ik / support keys are [[frame, weight], ...] at 30 fps and override the detectors (mount clips only). loop: true = the design plays the clip as a cycle (only real cycles; the manifest's `seamless` says whether the source's first and last poses match). weapon_frame: the weapon family whose library frame the keyed prop bones are converted to (weapon_frames.py; `weapon_frames` names the clips each frame is measured on). align_bake (mount clips): the ground -> saddle align the tool solves and bakes into the root (contacts.mount_align): ground frame `origin` / `yaw_deg` (horse.md 1.2), `switch` [ground until, saddle from], push-off `plant` window of the ground foot, `stirrup` window of the stirrup foot. weapon_seams: [from, to, kind] pairs the two-handed designs play back to back, checked for the weapon turning in the hand (checks.py; kind other than same_grip = a deliberate regrip, reported only). ship: false = retargeted for validation against a native Actor_B clip (`native`) but not written to the library.

blade._doc: library frame = Actor_B's own knife frame (blade along prop +Y); the Actor_A machete clips are converted

two_hand._doc: library frame = the keyed two-handed haft clips' frame (+Z from the left hand through the right hand to the working end); guard clips get it on B's palms, the long-gun clips are rolled / shifted onto it
